title: Qualify a bounded exact LaTeX import contract and explicit ambiguity convention
commitMessage: feat: qualify bounded LaTeX import with explicit ambiguity policy

contribution.summary: Qualify a closed .NET 10 LaTeX subset importer: exact fractions and real expressions, explicit multiplication, optional caller-declared x(y) convention, and typed refusals for non-injective square/power display, invalid syntax, unsupported macros and limits. Recover one compiled RED, pass 50 independent GREEN tests, eight NuGet-only probes and local package checks. Complete C02-T1 only; leave C02, W01 and M5 open.
contribution.value: Let independent Math consumers import selected exact LaTeX without silently guessing function application, executing TeX, converting to binary64 or claiming a general inverse renderer.
debtChanges: Keep RS068 target re-entry aligned with emitted evidence using one shared QualifiedStatus constant; preserve the compiled missing-API RED against codecs preview.2 before installing preview.3.
Admit a narrow deterministic ASCII LaTeX grammar for signed exact integers, reduced fractions, x/y/z, sqrt/abs, explicit cdot and bounded sums/grouping; preserve exact typed Math IR.
Default x(y) to Ambiguous and require a caller-selected Multiplication convention to admit mul(x,y), recording the applied policy in the result.
Refuse known T1 square(x)/pow(x,2) identical LaTeX as structurally ambiguous; never fabricate the unique source IR or a proof.
Distinguish Invalid, Unsupported, NonCanonical, Ambiguous and BudgetExceeded for arbitrary macros, missing delimiters, unreduced fractions, unknown functions and resource limits.
Pass 50 independent GREEN tests and one recovered RED; run focused codecs plus exact IR and quantities regressions under locked .NET 10 Release build.
Pack and independently inspect three local Math archives with actual net10 nuspec/dependency/SHA-256 receipts; execute eight isolated pinned NuGet-only consumer oracles.
Complete C02-T1 RED/GREEN/verification and T1 only. Activate C02 and keep M5/W01 in progress; leave C02-T2 and all later M5 integration work untouched.
contribution.nextAction: After durable RS068 success, prepare C02-T2 for semantic-loss provenance, adversarial TeX boundaries and integration without broadening the T1 closed grammar silently.
